goal.objective: Replace the rejected synthetic fresh-phase test with an isolated, exact production-entrypoint compile-to-verify lifecycle proof while freezing Revision 20 production code.

assumptions.statement: Executable trust, cache provenance, process isolation, and hostile same-user resistance remain external-host duties.
assumptions.rationale: The behavioral fixture proves repository routing without overstating host guarantees.

assumptions.statement: The isolated fixture may replace only its copied aggregate verify command with a bounded deterministic command before committing the fixture candidate.
assumptions.rationale: The test targets the gate-to-review lifecycle, while the real repository aggregate gate is verified separately.

assumptions.statement: Independent successor review, V11 refresh, candidate gate, R2, hosted CI, and merge remain integration-owner work.
assumptions.rationale: The test producer cannot approve its own release.

assumptions.statement: Revision 20 production source is semantically accepted and must remain byte-identical; Revision 21 changes tests only.
assumptions.rationale: The independent review found a proof defect, not a source-level identity defect.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Actual copied production entrypoints complete and prove the isolated gate, compile, approve, verify, output, handoff, receipt, promotion, and negative-route lifecycle while every production source byte remains exact.

evidenceRequirements.description: Provide exact source identities, fixture commit and exception, raw shared-output comparisons, package pair, handoff fan-in, parent receipts, negative routes, focused checks, cleanup, and residual boundaries.
